Heavy Rain Alert Issued for Haridwar, India

A heavy rain alert has been issued for Haridwar, India, with forecasters predicting heavy rainfall and strong winds on Monday. The decision to suspend public hearing in Haridwar was taken due to the heavy rain alert. The situation is being closely monitored by authorities.
